dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Island Government Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm:
Derived from 2020 aerial photo interpretation as well as a combination of PEI government staff fieldwork and consultant work. Updated May 2026.

Attributes:
FIELDID: Unique polygon number.
LANDUSE: Dominant land use category.
SUBUSE: Land use subcategory.
HECTARES: Polygon size in hectares.
CLASS1: Dominant wetland cover type.
WET_PER1: Percentage of the dominant land cover type.
CLASS2: Wetland cover type which is second most abundant.
WET_PER2: Percentage of second wetland cover type.
CLASS3: Wetland cover type which is third most abundant.
WET_PER3: Percentage of third wetland cover type.
CLASS4: Wetland cover type which is fourth most abundant.
WET_PER4: Percentage of fourth wetland cover type.
CLASS5: Wetland cover type which is fifth most abundant.
WET_PER5: Percentage of fifth wetland cover type.
CLASS6: Wetland cover type which is sixth most abundant.
WET_PER6: Percentage of sixth wetland cover type.
CLASS7: Wetland cover type which is seventh most abundant.
WET_PER7: Percentage of seventh wetland cover type.

Wetland Subuse Codes:
Reservoirs: RE
Sewage: SE
Forest: FOR

Land Cover Class Codes:
Bog: BOW
Brackish Marsh: BKW
Deep Marsh: DMW
Meadow: MDW
Open Water: OWW
Salt Marsh: SAW
Sand Dune: SDW
Seasonally Flooded Flat: SFW
Shallow Marsh: SMW
Shrub Swamp: SSW
Wooded Swamp: WSW
